company.shortDescription: Jamble is a fashion resale platform that enables users to buy and sell used clothing through live streaming and video.
company.description:
Jamble is a fashion resale platform that enables users to buy and sell used clothing. They provide resellers with video and live streaming technologies to help them sell more efficiently, as well as purchasers with a unique and appealing experience.

Jamble is headquartered in San Francisco, California and was founded in 2021.

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $9,663,098 to $9,663,098, a 1x increase.

caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 76 (-16 over 90 days) and market heat at 68 (-16).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
